question: Under the same one-extra-frame budget, does the frozen pose-diverse frame expose more positive screen-space object evidence than a frozen passive historical frame on multiple controlled device scenes?

selected.input: FLOAT32 [1,320,320,3] from exact owned RGBA receipt
selected.output: positive COCO label, confidence and source-raster bounding box
selected.source_identity: DetectorFrameResult.sourceFrame must exactly equal the owned-payload FrameStamp
selected.selection_inputs: pose receipts only; detector output is read after all arm identities are frozen

reasons: DepthFrameResult does not carry source-frame identity
output closeness is normalized independently per frame
no calibrated metric or cross-frame evidence semantics are available

frozen_shadow_protocol.analysis_unit: one exact reference payload with both passive and pose-diverse exact historical payloads inside one uninterrupted Anchor tracking epoch
frozen_shadow_protocol.scene_parent: caller-provided opaque scene_id; no address, image, raw box or user identity is persisted

arms.current_only: reference positive-token set; zero extra frames
arms.current_plus_passive: reference union one candidate nearest to a 500ms historical gap; tie by smaller gap then frame id
arms.current_plus_pose_diverse: reference union the frozen TARO_POSE_DIVERSE_GENERIC_R0 selection; one extra frame

frozen_shadow_protocol.candidate_pool: all exact payload receipts in the frozen 150ms..1s same-Anchor history; passive and pose-diverse read the same pool
frozen_shadow_protocol.inference_cache: one inference per unique complete FrameStamp; all arms reuse the same receipt
frozen_shadow_protocol.visual_token: COCO label plus 3x3 source-raster bounding-box-center bin

primary_focus_proxy.definition: a positive detection whose box intersects normalized x=[0.25,0.75], y=[0.50,1.00]
primary_focus_proxy.scope: screen-space central-lower proxy only; not a metric body/path capsule, collision label, clearance label or safe-route label

frozen_shadow_protocol.primary_metric: per-scene mean new focused positive visual tokens beyond current_only
secondary_metrics: all-raster new positive visual tokens beyond current_only
pose/passive tie and strict-win scene counts
exact identity, abstention and resource-error counts

claim_ceiling: This preflight selects and identity-binds one existing positive-only RGB backend and freezes a multi-scene same-budget shadow protocol. A future PASS would establish only additional frozen-model screen-space positive-evidence observability on those scenes, not detector accuracy, collision correctness, body/path geometry, product effectiveness or safety.
